history.committed: You suggested meeting on Wednesday afternoon.

acceptable_translations: That works for me.
I have no objection.
human_review_notes: 应表达对安排的接受；不可凭空添加出席承诺、具体时间或地点。示例不是唯一正确译法。

history.source: 我刚测试了本地网络，连接正常。
history.committed: I just tested my local network, and the connection is working.

acceptable_translations: Everything is working on my end.
There are no issues on my end.
human_review_notes: 应表达自己一侧没有故障；不可扩大为整个服务或所有用户都恢复正常。

history.source: 这个 API 的参数命名不一致。
history.committed: The parameter names in this API are inconsistent.

acceptable_translations: This API needs to be adjusted.
This interface needs to be adjusted.
human_review_notes: 讨论软件 API，不能翻成硬件连接器；若 interface 已足够明确也可以接受。不可自动声称必须改名或改协议。

history.source: 这块电路板上的电源连接器位置不合适。
history.committed: The power connector on this circuit board is in the wrong position.

acceptable_translations: This connector needs to be adjusted.
human_review_notes: 讨论物理连接器，应避免 API 含义；不可凭空确定连接器型号或具体移动距离。

history.source: 这个浏览器标签页一直在自动播放视频。
history.committed: This browser tab keeps autoplaying videos.

acceptable_translations: Close it first.
Close the tab first.
human_review_notes: it 指浏览器标签页；不能扩大成关闭整台电脑、删除视频或关闭整个浏览器。

acceptable_translations: Turn it off first.
Turn the fan off first.
human_review_notes: it 指风扇；close it 通常不能表达关闭电源。不可增加拔掉插头等操作。

history.source: 我们正在测量缓存命中率。
history.committed: We are measuring the cache hit rate.

acceptable_translations: The cache hit rate has improved.
The cache hit rate has increased.
human_review_notes: 沿用 cache hit rate；不增加具体增幅，不把命中率改成速度或容量。

history.source: 我已经给王女士发了邮件。
history.committed: I have already emailed Ms. Wang.

acceptable_translations: She hasn't replied to me yet.
human_review_notes: 保留 she、not yet 和回复对象；不可改成不愿回复、永远不会回复或因忙碌未回复。

history.source: 需要通过的测试共有 7 个，已有 5 个通过。
history.committed: There are 7 tests that need to pass, and 5 have passed so far.

acceptable_translations: There are still 2 tests to go.
2 more tests still need to pass.
human_review_notes: 可以补足 tests，但不可声称剩余测试已经失败。数字保留测试要求使用阿拉伯数字字面值。

history.source: 我在试着把这台打印机放进这个箱子里。
history.committed: 我在试着把这台打印机放进这个箱子里。

acceptable_translations: It won't fit in the box.
It doesn't fit.
human_review_notes: 从已知装箱情境理解 fit；不可推导为 GPU 显存不足或添加尺寸、重量原因。

history.committed: Temporary files can be cleaned up.

acceptable_translations: Do not delete the backup.
Don't delete the backups.
human_review_notes: 必须保留禁止删除的含义；前文允许清理临时文件不能覆盖当前否定。

source: 请把超时时间从 30 秒改成 45 秒。
acceptable_translations: Please change the timeout from 30 seconds to 45 seconds.
human_review_notes: 保留 30 到 45 的方向及秒单位；数字自动核对不代表单位和方向已通过。数字要求保持阿拉伯数字。

acceptable_translations: The failure rate fell from 2.5% to 1.2%.
human_review_notes: 保留百分号、小数及下降方向；不能转成成功率。数字自动核对按多重集合比较，顺序与语义仍需人工核查。

source: 这个改动可能会降低延迟，但还没有测试。

history.source: 我刚调整了请求调度逻辑。
history.committed: I just adjusted the request scheduling logic.

acceptable_translations: This change may reduce latency, but it hasn't been tested yet.
human_review_notes: 必须保留 may 和未测试状态；不可翻成已经降低延迟或已经验证。

acceptable_translations: He didn't make it clear.
He didn't explain it clearly.
human_review_notes: 没有上下文，应保持对象未指明；不可自行补成合同、技术方案或会议安排。

history.committed: I've already sent you the agenda.

history.source: 地点还是上次的会议室。
history.committed: The location is the same meeting room as last time.

acceptable_translations: I'll confirm the time later.
human_review_notes: 只翻译当前 source。不得重发议程、地点等历史内容，不添加确定的截止时间。
